snippet.title: Syncline Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Syncline is a grid puzzle about a line of cubes that moves by tumbling end over end. The free demo is out now.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4981070/Syncline/
Play the demo: https://www.indiedb.com/games/syncline
Discord: https://discord.gg/eMSybcz4Km

Your cubes are joined in a straight chain. Lying flat it rolls one cell at a time; stood upright it covers more ground but reaches higher. Rotate the camera in ninety-degree steps to read the level from another side, then find the sequence that leaves a cube touching every goal.

Roll the chain into a wall and it splits - the cubes that can move carry on, the ones that cannot are left behind on the grid, waiting to be picked up by a later tumble. Shortening the chain on purpose is usually the answer.

- Hand-authored level packs, each built around a different mechanic
- A built-in level editor, with a solver that verifies a level is solvable before you share it
- Community packs through mod.io - browse, subscribe and publish from inside the game
- Full keyboard and gamepad support, with rebindable controls
- English and Swedish

#indiegame #puzzlegame #indiedev
